problem: Payment fails when transaction id is missing
error: TypeError: payment.id is undefined at PaymentService.ts:42
rootCause: Code accessed payment.id before checking the payment object was fully populated
fix: Added null/undefined validation before accessing payment.id

rootCause: Expired token was not handled; verify threw instead of returning 401
fix: Added token-expiration handling and a graceful 401 response

problem: Dashboard shows blank page when the user has no projects
error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'map') at Dashboard.tsx:31
rootCause: Rendered projects.map before the projects array was loaded
fix: Added a loading state and defaulted projects to an empty array

problem: App crashes on startup when the .env file is missing
rootCause: No validation of required environment variables at boot
fix: Added an env schema check at startup that fails with a clear message
